(1) agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/git-commit-scoped.sh line ~461, the specs/.commit-lock fail-open WARNING, now asserts: 'two concurrent committers naming an OVERLAPPING path can drop that path from one writer's own commit even though each commit is individually path-scoped (reproduced; this is NOT the safe case this comment used to claim)'. So no concurrency drop was reproduced by that task; the claim rests only on a flaky research harness it deliberately declined to port.
